description: This PHP class 'AuthenticationService' handles user authentication logic within the OrangeHRM system, including setting user credentials, verifying user status, and managing user attributes such as roles, employee numbers, and modification dates.

classes.name: AuthenticationService
classes.description: A service class responsible for handling user authentication, credential setting, and user attribute management within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setCredentialsForUser
methods.description: Verifies and sets credentials for a given user, throwing exceptions if the user is disabled, not assigned, or terminated.

methods.name: setCredentials
methods.description: Retrieves user credentials and delegates to setCredentialsForUser to validate and set user attributes.

methods.name: setUserAttributes
methods.description: Sets user-related attributes in the authentication context, including user ID, role, employee number, and last modified date.
